profile.summary: A nonprofit organization based in Oakland, California, that operates under the name West Oakland Cultural Action Network (WOCAN). WOCAN supports efforts to preserve and uplift the cultural, political, economic and social conditions of the Hoover, Clawson and McClymonds neighborhoods of West Oakland.
